{{Quote|Really, the sculpture was not an outstanding piece.|Cham and Nog Teleus on Gomalo's bas-relief sculpture|<ref name="PortRod" />}}
'''Cham Teleus''' was a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] industrialist who made a fortune on<ref name="PortRod" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] along with their significant other [[Nog Teleus]]. Together, the couple decided to relocate to<ref name="PortRod" /> the Expansion Region's<ref name="CularinWhere">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]</ref> [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and, to celebrate their new home, organized a number of events to mark the 125th [[Standard year/Legends|anniversary]] of the signing of the [[Cularin Compact]]. The jollities included festivals, [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]], other competitions, and a display of native [[Tarasin]] and other local artworks including a number from the Teleus' private collection. A number of items were stolen by [[Gomalo]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] recently released from [[Prison/Legends|prison]]; the haul included a [[bas-relief sculpture]] created by him. The item contained the coded location of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in which he had stowed the body of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ji-Ad Sarain]] frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="PortRod" />

{{RPGseed}}
Cham and Nog sought help from the [[Cularin Office of Public Safety|Office of Public Safety]], who assigned [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Ezra Du'Re]] to recover the sculpture. The artwork was eventually recovered by Du'Re with the aid of a group from [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], to whom the Tynnans offered generous rewards for returning most of their possessions and rescuing Sarain.<ref name="PortRod" />
{{EndGame}}

The pair later sponsored the inaugural [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race.<ref name="CV" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Buy yourself a spiffy new robe or something else nice.|Cham and Nog Teleus to any Jedi players|<ref name="PortRod" />}}
Cham Teleus first appeared in "[[Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian]]", an adventure written by [[Nate Christen]] for the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign in [[2004]]. Each of the players can receive 200 credits from Cham and Nog Teleus, as well as small replicates of Gomalo's bas-relief sculpture if the mission is completed successfully. If any of the player characters are Jedi, Cham and Nog will recommend the purchasing of a new robe.<ref name="PortRod" />
